Did: components/preparation/sources-panel.tsx, mounted under Purpose on the preparation page. Section 'Sources' with Paste (Radix dialog: Title, Text, 'Add source'; errors stay in the dialog as role=alert linked to the textarea) and Import (documents_import; null = cancel). Rows list available documents (deleted filtered out) with a MD/TXT badge, title, 'Markdown · 18 KB · v2 · Ready' (Reading… / Couldn't read text in coral), and an include dot: a 24px button with aria-pressed and label 'Included in the brief: <title>' / 'Not included in the brief: <title>'; disabled for failed extraction. A paste or import that succeeds reloads documents_list and, when extracted, appends {kind:'document', versionId} to the selection via prep_select_sources. Selection changes are queued and computed from the latest saved selection (a ref), so quick toggles never send a stale set; knowledge entries are preserved. Error map: SOURCE_TOO_LARGE:MAX_SOURCE_BYTES -> 'This source is over 1 MB. Split it or paste a shorter part.', :MAX_SOURCE_CHARS and :MAX_PASSAGES have their own messages, plus UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT, EMPTY_SOURCE, DOCUMENT_TITLE_REQUIRED, SOURCE_UNREADABLE, SELECTION_TOO_LARGE, SOURCE_NOT_ELIGIBLE; anything else 'Couldn't add this source.'. New src/lib/preparation-service.ts (listSelectedSources, selectSources, SelectedSource type). base-ipc.json stubs documents_list and prep_list_sources as []. Gallery screens: preparation-sources-empty, preparation-sources-three, preparation-paste-dialog, preparation-paste-size-error (checked light and dark). 11 tests in tests/components/preparation-sources.test.tsx (ui/dialog mocked as passthrough).
